opportunities.title: Hydra render path: sync/async/text-scope triple dispatch in one file
opportunities.description: renderTikzToSvg and renderTikzToSvgAsync share pipeline steps but re-implement plumbing with three scope branches; port collapses to one santized render() with an explicit Scene cache and no async cooperative machinery for headless parity.

opportunities.title: Max file 7680 LOC (emit.ts 2346, evaluate.ts 3767, path/graph.ts 3789)
opportunities.description: Census: max_file_loc 7680, avg 295, 80.5% under 400. Port enforces <=400 LOC/module with small pure modules.

opportunities.title: Comment density 3.3% across 185677 code LOC
opportunities.description: Scan census: 6179 comment lines for 185677 code LOC. Port targets >=15% rustdoc with doc-tested public APIs.

opportunities.title: Deterministic evaluation enables span>scene cache -> instant re-renders
opportunities.description: Legacy re-evaluates figures on edits; port will key interim Scene by figure range to avoid re-evaluating unedited figures (numbers pending PGO bench).

opportunities.title: Option comment mask misreads escaped-backslash comments
opportunities.description: maskLineComments uses a 1-char lookbehind with no backslash pairing, so a backslash-backslash-percent sequence is misread as an escaped percent and the TeX comment is not masked. Rust port replicates the legacy masking exactly to keep spans/diagnostics in parity.

opportunities.title: Style keys lowercased -> case-colliding style names
opportunities.description: Option and flag keys are toLowerCase()d before the store; PGF style names are case-sensitive, so MyStyle/.style and mystyle/.style collide. Rust keeps PGF case-sensitivity and documents the divergence.

opportunities.title: Color sniff misclassifies hyphenated/underscored names
opportunities.description: looksLikeColorSpecification restricts component names to alnum, so blue-gray!50 misses the 5-token percent chain; xcolor handling must match accepted and rejected forms for identical diagnostics.

opportunities.title: Scanner-grammar divergence for trivia after begin
opportunities.description: readTexEnvironmentDelimiter supports allowTrivia but figure-scan calls it with false, so begin/newline/name is invisible to the Rust-relevant scanner while the lezer grammar still sees it. Corpus is safe; port pins adjacent-brace behavior.

opportunities.title: Recovered diagnostics tie on equal spans -> push order matters
opportunities.description: Diagnostics sort by span only (shared.ts compareDiagnosticPosition), so equal (from,to) pairs keep insertion order. Rust comparator must tie-break identically or verify no equal-span collisions in the corpus.

opportunities.title: Flag regex over-accepts free text as arrows
opportunities.description: Arrow-sniff regex accepts multi-word free text as flags; malformed options degrade into plausible flag entries instead of unknown. Rust pins the same classifier for diagnostic parity.

opportunities.title: Style value strips exactly one outer brace pair
opportunities.description: parseStyleValueAsOptionList removes one outer {...} only; {{...}} or {a}{b} residue plus approximate no-brace span math are legacy quirks; port strips identically.

opportunities.title: Picture recovery keeps first begin under nested env
opportunities.description: begin ??= environment recovery pins the first begin and skips non-matching ends; documented recovery boundary to replicate.

opportunities.title: Unresolved placeholder heuristic scans any #digit
opportunities.description: containsUnresolvedMacroPlaceholder treats any #digit in picture text (outside comments, ## and \# skipped via 2-char escape step) as unresolved; scan order must be ported verbatim.

opportunities.title: Incremental parse falls back hard on any global diagnostic
opportunities.description: One global diagnostic forces full-figure re-parse; per-statement cache demands zero global diagnostics. Deferred for Rust: one-shot rendering needs no incremental session (1,076 LOC).

opportunities.title: structuralMasks splits node text into parallel field
opportunities.description: Masked structural text is re-sliced per node, giving text vs structuralText divergence; editor-only. Rust corpus path disables masks entirely.

opportunities.title: toFixed(4) tie-rounding differs from Rust formatting
opportunities.description: JS toFixed rounds ties toward the larger integer candidate on the exact decimal expansion of the double (-0.00005 -> '0' while Rust half-away gives -0.0001). Port must implement the ECMAScript toFixed algorithm, with 0.00005/-0.00005/2.675 golden tie tests.

opportunities.title: Stable SVG ids hash UTF-16 code units
opportunities.description: FNV-1a over UTF-16 code units with Math.imul semantics and >>> 0 base36; hashing UTF-8 bytes diverges on non-ASCII signatures. Rust: wrapping_mul(0x01000193) over UTF-16 codepoint sequence.

opportunities.title: viewBox re-measures only marker/shorten paths in degenerate frame
opportunities.description: computeViewBox measures in {y:0,height:0} then re-flips; correct only because worldToSvgPoint collapses, but any stroke-math change silently corrupts bounds. Ordinary strokes rely on the semantic ±lineWidth/2 AABB, over-expanding rotated frames.

opportunities.title: 1.15em vs 1.05 line-height conventions disagree
opportunities.description: estimateTextBlockWidth/Height uses 1.15 per line while plain node layout uses fontSize*1.05, so a text element without blockHeight lays out at 1.15 but sizes its node box at 1.05. Port documents and replicates.

opportunities.title: Arrow shortening endpoint-order quirk
opportunities.description: Endpoint-only shortening processes the end token first and lets a start overrun flip the direction (documented PGF quirk); only the last subpath shortens when tips exist. Port keeps both orderings.

opportunities.title: Degenerate shading fit silently renders unfilled
opportunities.description: computeShadingTransform bails to plain fill when fitted scale <= 1e-4 with no diagnostic; mimic exactly.

opportunities.title: Two ellipse-bounds conventions coexist
opportunities.description: Kappa-0.55228475 based extent for shading fitting vs analytic computeSvgEllipseBounds for bounds; replicate per call-site or shading angles drift.

opportunities.title: Miter join bound approximates SVG miter-length rule
opportunities.description: Offset-point bound includes a miter point only when offset length <= miterLimit*halfWidth, while SVG tests lineWid=dth/sin(theta/2) <= miterLimit; strict pixel-parity could diverge at extreme corners.

opportunities.title: partId collision appends '#2'/'#3' suffixes
opportunities.description: Duplicate basePartIds get #N suffixes (hard duplicate throws); ids are internal but live-DOM anchoring depends on the exact scheme, so port it verbatim.

opportunities.title: Part fingerprint is the whole markup string
opportunities.description: Equivalence uses full markup equality and defs.join; any attribute-order change flips patching to replaceAll fallback (incremental-only concern, kept for edit-time slice).

opportunities.title: escapeText deliberately leaves quotes unescaped
opportunities.description: Text nodes escape only & < >; attributes add " -> ". Browser-compatible but not strictly XML-safe; keep byte-identical rather than 'more correct'.

opportunities.title: Patch insertion anchored to next model's prior part
opportunities.description: insertionIndex derives afterPartId from the next model's findPreviousPartIdInOrder with append-at-end fallback; a Rust rewrite must not switch to before-anchoring or edit-time ordering diverges.

opportunities.title: read_tex_control_sequence split a multibyte char after backslash
opportunities.description: Port used from+2 BYTES for control symbols; backslash followed by a non-ASCII char panicked on slice (found by proptest token_soup). JS indexes UTF-16 units so legacy never panics. Fixed: advance by len_utf8 of the next char, regression test added.

opportunities.title: Blueprint parity plan assumed wrapper geometry compares without text engine; goldens say otherwise
opportunities.description: Goldens were captured in TeX text mode. svg_diff.py requires identical element counts and glyph presence, and viewBox/flip/node sizes depend on glyph metrics. Option set: (a) port Latin Modern metrics + OT1 shaper, (b) add a geometry-only comparator mode plus new text-free goldens (needs a legacy run), (c) accept 1/11 as the parity ceiling for this slice.

opportunities.title: Cargo.lock v4 and egui 0.33 need cargo >= 1.78/1.88; apt gives 1.75
opportunities.description: Sandbox builds a scratch workspace without tikz-app, proptest pinned to 1.4.0 and tempfile 3.10.1 (edition2024 crates in newer resolves). Repo manifests untouched. tikz-app and llvm-profdata/PGO need a newer toolchain.

test_iterations.failures_summary: doctest region::to_group_inner_span: span 17..20 pointed at '} {' not '{2}' (bytes are 19..22); 8 clippy lints (bool simplify, useless .into(), 6x assert_eq! on bool)
test_iterations.fix_applied: none (baseline run on apt rustc 1.75, scratch workspace without tikz-app, proptest pinned 1.4.0)
doctest span -> 19..22/20..21; parenthesised bool in coordinate.rs; dropped useless .into() in stmt_macro.rs; assert_eq!(x,bool)->assert!

parity_iterations.divergence_cause: 10/11 goldens contain TeX-mode text (data-text-renderer=tex, per-glyph <path>). svg_diff.py needs equal element counts and glyph presence; viewBox, y-flip constant and node box sizes all depend on Latin Modern glyph metrics, so even path d values shift. Not fixable without the deferred text engine. Rust emits explicit diagnostics (exit 3) for these, never a wrong SVG. Only minimal.tex (no text) is in reach.
parity_iterations.fix_applied: none yet; minimal passes byte-identical (cmp) and via svg_diff 2/2 elems max_abs_err=0

benchmarks.label: 1. Legacy TypeScript Baseline
benchmarks.notes: PURPOSE: supersedes earlier 6-doc entry. Workload: 11-doc corpus x 10 fresh full-pipeline renders (parse->semantic->svg), warm loop of 110 renders in 624.4ms (5.68ms/doc). Peak RSS = RUSAGE_CHILDREN incl node+font engine; process startup outside warm loop measured 1596.5ms total.
